lines.en: Another morning means another chance to hang around an attractive girl, and so I find myself where I have found myself on several occasions now-
And probably even more occasions in a life I can’t remember.
The only issue this time around is that the girl in question has yet to notice my presence and I have now been standing here for going on five minutes.
What’s even worse is that there are other people here. And seeing as Futaba is the only working volunteer, it has fallen on me to help all of the people she has ignored.
This may come as a surprise to you, but I am not very good at helping people.
So I am sorry to everyone who I have misinformed today, but that is simply how things must be until I am able to snap the regular weekend librarian out of her daydream-induced stupor.
: Futaba, for the millionth time, good morning.
Whatever is going on inside that head of hers must be pretty interesting if even hearing my voice, the one she adores so much, is not enough to snap her out of it.
But, then again, it might not be very interesting at all seeing as how every time I get caught in a daydream like that, one of my hands ends up inside of my pants.
Futaba has yet to make such a move, unfortunately. And as much as it pains me to say this, I’d have to break her out of it if she did.
I am all for the idea of watching her pleasure herself in the library, but doing so in a room full of other students would very likely not be a good move for me.
So, what are some other things I can think about in the time between now and whenever Futaba wakes up?
Oh. The weather is nice today. Clouds are expected in the afternoon, with the morning being a bit on the colder side compared to the norm as of late.
The birds are chirping, the sun is shining, and I am still an incorrigible predator waiting to feast upon the flesh of an overly-developed teenage girl.
Good morning, world. I am here.
: Futaba. Please snap out of it before my thoughts start spiraling even further into the abyss.
: Futaba. I really need-
: Huh? Sensei? What’s wrong?
: And...how long have you been there exactly?
: Probably ten minutes now. I was only a few more away from calling an ambulance.
: I’m so sorry, Sensei. I started reading a new book last night and...I suppose I may have started thinking about it while waiting for you to show up.
: Why not just...keep reading the book?
: Because I left it at home.
: Futaba, this is a library. Just get another copy.
: I’m okay with waiting until I get back home. It wouldn’t be right for me to spend my time getting absorbed in something when there are people here who need assistance.
: Yeah, about that. A bunch of people have needed assistance and you kind of just ignored them.
: I...what?!
: Futaba, don’t yell. This is a library.
: How...How many people have I ignored?
: I stopped counting after three.
: Why would you stop counting after such a low number?
: Why would you forsake your responsibility as a librarian and neglect your job? This is on you, not me.
: Sensei...you...wouldn’t happen to know what time it is, would you?
: Probably somewhere around 10:00 AM. I stopped keeping track of that as well.
: We’re still in the library, you know. People are trying to study and you have done nothing but make things harder for them today.
: I...haven’t even started reorganizing the shelves yet. And I promised I’d have the entire library done by noon...
: Sensei...you...wouldn’t mind helping-
: Oh, no. I’ve already helped over three people today. If I wanted to help more than that, I’d just start volunteering here myself.
: Hah...I suppose I’ll just have to stay later then. This is the price I must pay for letting my imagination run wild again.
: If it’s any consolation, I’m not opposed to standing around and further preventing you from doing your job with continued conversation about what was going on in your head a few minutes ago.
: At this point, I think that would be fine...I’m already going to have to stay late anyway, so having you around might actually make time go by a little faster.
: Then, by all means, start organizing your shelves or whatever it is you need to do while I transition back into the unhelpful burden of a man I am meant to be.
Futaba tears herself away from the desk, closing a notebook that only has a small handful of words scribbled into it, before making her way across the library.
I think to myself about whether or not she’d only gotten sucked into daydreaming because she was attempting to write, but ultimately ignore the thought as it doesn’t really interest me.
Unfortunately, the thought comes back just a few moments later when I can’t think of anything else to talk to Futaba about.
: So...is everything okay, Futaba?
: Hm? Of course. Everything is completely fine, Sensei. I just get caught up in little daydreams like that from time to time. It’s nothing to worry over, really.
: I saw you close a notebook before we got up. Were you trying to write something?
: That’s...um...well...
: To be honest, I’m not really sure how to put this...
: Are you...embarrassed to be caught writing or something?
: It’s less embarrassment about being caught writing and...more embarrassment about exactly what I was writing.
: I’ve always had problems...coming up with my own stories, so...I often find myself just adding to stories made by other people.
: Like...writing unofficial sequels or something like that?
: Kind of?...Not just sequels, but...side stories and...alternate scenarios and...things like that.
: There’s a term for it. Fan fiction. But a lot of people frown upon it since it’s not entirely original and...the quality of a lot of it is...really, really bad.
: I’m...sure that nothing I do really helps to...break that stigma, but...it keeps me occupied when I’m not actually reading.
: W...What I’d really like to do is eventually come up with my own stories, though! From the ground up!
: A good friend of mine from my old school does that...and she’s found a lot of success in...umm...certain circles.
: I can’t imagine I’ll ever be anywhere as good as her since she’s always been a sort of prodigy, but...I think it would be really nice to also be able to do something like that one day.
: Interesting.
: Well, I don’t know anything about this fan fiction stuff, but I’m sure that you’d be able to write an original story if you actually apply yourself.
: You certainly read enough to know what would make a good book.
: I do...But, as I’m sure you know, reading and writing are two completely different beasts.
: And just because I read a lot doesn’t mean that I’ll be able to come up with an interesting story.
: That doesn’t, no. But what about whatever daydream you were having when I showed up?
: That...daydream was another one of my...umm...alternate timelines ideas again...
: Are they all like that?
: All of them? No. I have plenty of original ones too. I just-
: Then how about writing one of those?
: If they’re interesting enough to tear you away from reality for ten minutes at a time, I’m sure there are plenty of other people who’d enjoy reading them as well.
: Well...yes. They’re interesting to me...But who’s to say that someone else will enjoy them as much as I do?
: Who’s to say literally anything in this life? Caring more about what others think about your work means nothing compared to what you think about it.
: So what if no one else enjoys it? As long as you do, isn’t it worth the effort?
Futaba pauses for a moment as blood begins to pool in her cheeks and I think about how strange it is that words alone can influence the fluids inside of a person’s body.
I wonder if her words will ever do that for someone else?
And I wonder what type of words they would be.
: You’re...
: You’re so cool...
: Thanks, Futaba. I try.
: Oh! Uhh...haha! I didn’t really mean to say that out loud...but I guess it just kind of slipped out.
: That was...a really inspiring thing to say, though...But I guess if anyone was going to be able to give me the push I needed, it would be you.
: I’m sure it won’t be the last time I push you. In fact, what if I give you a little assignment to push you even further?
: An assignment?
: Yeah. Take one of those original daydreams of yours and try turning it into a full-fledged story. The kind without characters who already exist in properties owned by other people.
: I’ll read it and give you my honest thoughts along with any criticism I may have.
: You...would really go out of your way for me like that?
: Sure.  Writing is a mutated reflection of a person’s innermost self.
: The more you put on paper, the more I’ll understand you.
And the more I understand you, the closer we’ll become.
: And if it’s not good?...
: If I can’t write something that...serves as a reflection...will that ruin your chances of ever understanding me?
: No clue. I can’t predict the future.
: I just don’t think it’s fair to hold yourself back from something you want to do just because you’re afraid of what other people would think.
: Especially when one of those other people is standing right in front of you, telling you to go for it.
Futaba locks eyes with me in disagreement with what the pools of blood inside her cheeks would have her do.
She pushes back, but her words do not influence my bodily fluids the way mine influenced hers.
: Okay...
: I’ll do it. I’ll start writing something. Something original.
: I want you to understand me a little better, Sensei.
: I want to write something you can be proud of.
: I had a feeling you’d say that.
: I won’t give you a due date or anything, obviously. You’re free to do this at your own leisure. And if you need any suggestions or help with anything, feel free to ask.
: Just don’t tell any of the other girls about this since I am absolutely giving you special treatment right now.
: Can I...or...umm...
: Is it okay if I ask...why you’re giving me special treatment?...
Her blood wins out in the end.
She turns away.
: I don’t really have a reason for it.
: I guess I just have a soft spot for girls who write.
: Then...
: I’ll do my best to become one of those girls.
I don’t stay around for much longer as Futaba still has a decent amount of work to do and my presence has all but prevented her from getting anything done at all.
As such, I take my leave and begin to look for something else to do with the rest of my day.
I have no idea what Futaba will manage to create...or even if it will be any good.
But at least she’s going to try.
Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
I quickly kneel down beside Futaba to make sure she’s still alive. Once I confirm she is, my mind navigates elsewhere.
Ahh, pantyhose. What a wonderful invention.
Though, I have to say, I think I’d prefer her without them at this particular moment in time.
But nonetheless, this is an image I will ingrain into my mind.
: Sensei...You scared me...
: Are you okay? That was quite the fall.
: I think so. My butt kind of hurts but other than that I think I’ll be fine.
: Want me to rub it for you?
: Huh?! M-my-my??
: Relax. I’m just kidding.
: What kind of joke is that?...
: You should really be careful from now on, you know. If you landed on your neck you could have died.
: I know, I know...This happens so often that you’d think I’d be prepared for it by now.
: How often do you fall off stepladders? I can’t imagine this being a majorly recurring event.
: I don’t mean just stepladders, obviously.
: I’m just sort of clumsy in general...
: That’s nothing to feel bad about. We all have our moments.
: Then to make things worse, the teacher slipped on one and landed flat on her face.
: That’s...kind of gross...
: Is this...supposed to make me feel better?
: Depends. Is it working?
: Hmm...Maybe just a little.
: Well I’m glad. Because none of that story was true and now I feel bad about lying to you.
: You made all of that up off the top of your head?
: Yeah. I didn’t know where I was going with it at first but it just sort of filled itself in.
: I guess that’s to be expected from someone like you.
: What do you mean by that?
: N-Nothing in particular...Just that you’re really smart and creative and stuff.
: I wish I could be as creative as you.
: Oh come on, I’m sure you can do a million times better than some dead frogs and a messed up teacher.
Maybe I can talk to her about those?
: Say, you daydream a lot, don’t you?
: I never really noticed.
: Yup. You zone out in class every once in a while. It’s not a big deal, though.
: What I’m getting at is why not try turning those daydreams into something creative?
: Do you mean like...writing a book?
: Sure. A book, poetry, maybe even painting.
: I’m not really that good with my hands...I don’t think painting would work out.
: Well then how about one of the first two? I could help you if you need it.
: It’ll be my way of apologizing for inadvertently causing you to fall off a stepladder and flash me.
: Flash you?
: You...are aware that I can see up your skirt, correct?
Ah, I guess she didn’t realize it after all.
: Why didn’t you say anything sooner?
Who in their right mind would do such a thing?
: I’m sorry you had to see me that way...
: There’s no need to apologize. It’s not like I could really see your underwear through the pantyhose.
: I don’t think that’s the issue here...
: So, what do you say about the whole ‘harnessing your creative vision' thing?
: I didn’t hear an answer before you started collecting yourself.
: Do...you really think I can?
: Well you won’t know until you try, right?
: You’ve really never tried writing a book or poem or anything like that?
: Well, of course I’ve tried, but...
: Nothing ever really comes out how I want it to.
: Well then let me help you. I’m your teacher.
Or, at least I’m pretending to be your teacher. I don’t really think I’m qualified...
: But...aren’t you busy with the rest of the class?
: You’re just as important as everyone else, Futaba.
: Is something wrong?
: No, I’m just-
: ...Not really used to hearing you call me by my first name yet.
: Heh~ It’s kind of like we’re real friends...
: That’s right. And friends help each other out when they need us.
: And so as your teacher and your friend, I’m giving you an extra homework assignment.
: Extra homework? What do I need to do?
: Write me something. Anything. A poem, a short story...But it needs to be about something you feel.
: It can be a daydream, a secret, whatever. But I’m going to need it done by Affection level 10.
: By...when?
: Sorry. I meant to say that I need it done soon.
: Hehe~ Okay. I’ll do it. I can’t promise it will be any good, though.
Futaba and I spend the next few minutes cleaning up the books she knocked over when she fell.
Before I know it, I’m heading back outside to get on with my day...
Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
